### 🚀 Pre-Release: v2.1.0b1 — USB OpenZigBee Gateway (`BTicino 3578` / `Legrand 088328`) & OWNd 2.1.0b1 (Field-Testing Beta)

First `v2.1` beta on **`OWNd 2.1.0b1`**. Requires **Home Assistant 2026.8 or newer** (Python 3.14).

#### ✨ Highlights (`#233`)
- **USB / Serial OpenZigBee Gateway (`BTicino 3578` / `Legrand 088328`)**: Exclusive `serialx` (`19200 8N1`) transport via `OWNd 2.1.0b1`, manual serial port picker (`SelectSelector(custom_value=True)` supporting `/dev/serial/by-id/...`, `/dev/ttyUSB*`, `socket://`, and `rfc2217://` Docker USB/IP bridges), live `*13*60*##` -> `*#13**16##` -> `*#13**12##` probe, 8-octet IEEE EUI-64 gateway identity (`dr.CONNECTION_ZIGBEE`), cached `.storage` product inventory for zero-RF boot, and yield-aware background / `myhome.sweep_bus` mesh discovery.
- **Context-Gated OpenZigBee Addressing (`WHO 1, 2, 13`)**: `<ADDR><UNIT>#9`, `0#00#9`, `0#9`, and `#<G>#9` frames decode as ZigBee exclusively on `address_family="zigbee"` gateways, preserving 100% TCP/SCS wire-frame equivalence (`*4*1*012#9##`, `*1*1*#9##`). Multi-unit endpoints group under one physical Home Assistant device per ZigBee node (`{eui64}-zigbee-{addr}`), and `WHAT 32 / 34 / 39` act as event-only frames (`myhome_zigbee_light_event` on `WHAT 32` toggle) without polling wireless senders.
- **Raw Bus Monitor & Privacy-First Diagnostics**: Captures every raw `##` serial token into the Lovelace Bus Monitor (`context: "zigbee"` trace export, `USB / Serial` telemetry) and redacts serial paths, USB serial numbers, and EUI-64 identifiers in diagnostics and `anonymize_plant_fixture.py`.

Docs: https://openwebnet-ha.github.io/MyHOME/beta/
Feedback and traces: https://github.com/OpenWebNet-HA/MyHOME/issues/233
